name: google-vision
description: Google Cloud Vision with an API key: OCR, labels, faces, safe search, logos, landmarks and objects in images

nodes.title: Read text (OCR)
nodes.description: OCR an image: returns {text, locale}. mode dense (default) for documents and photos of pages, sparse for signs and labels

image.description: An https URL (downloaded by the plugin), a gs:// URI, or an absolute path inside GOOGLE_VISION_UPLOAD_DIR

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (or a data: URL) instead of image

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.description: Find faces with bounding boxes and emotion likelihoods (joy, sorrow, anger, surprise); no identity recognition

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (or a data: URL) instead of image

include_landmarks.description: Include the ~35 facial landmark points per face

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Annotate images (batch)
nodes.description: Vision's images:annotate for up to 16 images: responses[i] belongs to requests[i] and may hold its own error

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Annotate PDF/TIFF files
nodes.description: OCR up to 5 pages of one inline PDF, TIFF or GIF: responses[0].responses[page]

requests.description: One request (Vision takes a single file per call): {"inputConfig":{"content":"<base64>","mimeType":"application/pdf"},"features":[{"type":"DOCUMENT_TEXT_DETECTION"}],"pages":[1,2]}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
